description:
1 Dialer System Management
• Set up, configure, and maintain dialer systems (Predictive/Preview/Progressive Dialer).
• Manage customer data lists (import/export, allocate by campaigns).
• Ensure contact rate, compliance with regulations and company policies (Do Not Call list, telecom/financial regulations if applicable).
2 Call Center Operations Support
• Coordinate with Team Leaders to allocate data and adjust campaigns.
• Develop daily campaign schedules for telesales teams — from strategic planning to execution.
• Monitor real-time performance (SL, AHT, Occupancy, Abandon rate, etc.).
• Troubleshoot system issues and coordinate with IT when necessary. 3 Data Allocation Strategy & Execution
• Design and implement data allocation strategies to optimize agent performance and campaign efficiency.
• Segment, prioritize, and distribute data lists based on historical results and conversion potential.
• Track and evaluate outcomes of allocation strategies, recommending improvements where necessary. 4 Reporting & Analysis
• Prepare daily/weekly/monthly dialer performance reports.
• Analyze contact trends and propose initiatives to improve contact rate and agent productivity.
5 Compliance & Quality
• Ensure dialer operations follow processes and legal compliance.
• Conduct regular checks to avoid data duplication or discrepancies.
